import copy,fcntl,json,pickle,sys,traceback
from pathlib import Path
from experiments.decision_evidence_transfer import RankedOnline,EDIT_FEEDBACK_METHOD,evidence_proposals,procedure_payload
from legal_skill_guard.learning.experiment import ROOT,read,sha,now,points
from legal_skill_guard.learning.member_learning import paired_effect
from legal_skill_guard.experiment.storage import RunStore
from legal_skill_guard.utils.hashing import canonical_json_sha256 as csha

class PendingFinalExecution(RankedOnline):
    def teacher_call(self,*a,**k):
        raise AssertionError("No new teacher, new edit, candidate gate or rollback in this completion")
    def execute(self):
        assert self.cfg["method"]==EDIT_FEEDBACK_METHOD
        reference=ROOT/self.cfg["reference_run"]
        terminal=read(ROOT/self.cfg["reference_terminal_preservation"])
        assert terminal["state"]=="terminal_results_preserved" and terminal["all_members_verified"]
        assert sha(terminal["archive"])==sha(terminal["rootdisk_copy"])==terminal["archive_sha256"]
        failure=read(reference/"failure.json")
        assert failure["actual_new_native_teacher_calls"]==[64,3]
        assert "Operator stop" in failure["error"] and not (reference/"completion.json").exists()
        pub=read(ROOT/self.cfg["parent_publication"])
        assert pub["original_seen_source_ids"]==[r["id"] for r in self.past+self.documents[:24]]
        self.bank=copy.deepcopy(pub["publication"]);self.parent=copy.deepcopy(self.bank)
        self.validate_runtime_bank();self.current_batch=3
        ordinary=read(reference/"ordinary_controls/after_b2.json")
        assert sha(ordinary["path"])==ordinary["sha256"]
        with Path(ordinary["path"]).open("rb") as stream:self.prefix_model=pickle.load(stream)
        self.prefix_ids=ordinary["source_ids"]
        assert self.prefix_ids==[r["id"] for r in self.past+self.documents[:16]]
        originals=[read(p) for p in sorted((reference/"logical_answers").rglob("*.json"))]
        assert len(originals)==64 and len({u["response"]["raw_id"] for u in originals})==64
        assert not (reference/"logical_answers/b3_after_seen").exists()
        self.units=self.score(originals)
        self.record("declaration.json",{"at":now(),"config":self.cfg,"frozen_bindings":self.bindings.copy(),
            "actual_latest_R17_bank":self.bank,"source_run_remains_failed_not_overwritten":True,
            "inherited_actual_native_teacher_CPUfits":[64,3,2],"new_native_teacher_CPUfits":[24,0,1],
            "same_episode_not_restart_independent_repeat_or_official_TEST":True,
            "all8_B3_postanswers_and_all8_B4_two_arms_fixed_before_any_R17_generation":True})
        checked=[]
        for row in self.documents[16:24]:
            leads=evidence_proposals(self.prefix_model,row,self.labels)
            messages,schema=procedure_payload(row,self.labels,leads,self.cfg["bundled_solver_system"],
                self.bank,public_reason_words=64)
            old=read(reference/f"inputs/b3_prequential/{row['id']}/skills.json")
            expected=json.loads(old["messages"][1]["content"])
            expected["learned_legal_procedures"]=[{"hypothesis_ids":s["hypothesis_ids"],"procedure":s["guidance"]["procedure"]} for s in self.bank]
            assert messages[0]==old["messages"][0] and schema==old["schema"]
            assert messages[1]["content"]==json.dumps(expected,ensure_ascii=False,separators=(",",":"))
            checked.append(row["id"])
        self.record("pending_all8_native_input_equivalence.json",{"at":now(),"source_ids":checked,
            "only_actual_latest_bank_changed_from_R16_to_R17":True,"no_new_generation_or_Gold":True})
        before=[u for u in self.units if u["stage"]=="b3_prequential" and u["condition"]=="skills"]
        assert len(before)==8 and all(u["ordinary_tool_source_ids"]==self.prefix_ids for u in before)
        self.phase="b3_after_seen"
        for row in self.documents[16:24]:
            self.joint(row,"skills",evidence_proposals(self.prefix_model,row,self.labels))
        after=self.score(self.answers);self.units.extend(after)
        effect=paired_effect(before,after,seed=2026101813,replicates=5000)
        self.record("update_effects/b3.json",{"at":now(),"effect":effect,
            "actual_publication_is_inherited_not_republished":True,"actual_same194_tool_training_only":True,
            "source_ids":[r["id"] for r in self.documents[16:24]]})
        self.fit_prefix(self.documents[:24])
        assert self.prefix_ids==pub["original_seen_source_ids"] and len(self.prefix_ids)==202
        self.current_batch=4;self.phase="b4_prequential";start=len(self.answers)
        for index,row in enumerate(self.documents[24:]):
            leads=evidence_proposals(self.prefix_model,row,self.labels)
            for arm in (("joint_empty","skills") if index%2==0 else ("skills","joint_empty")):
                self.joint(row,arm,leads)
        assert len(self.native)==24 and len(self.answers)==24 and not self.teachers and len(self.fit_records)==1
        final=self.score(self.answers[start:]);self.units.extend(final)
        groups={a:[u for u in final if u["condition"]==a] for a in ("joint_empty","skills")}
        summary={"at":now(),"batch":4,"prequential_metrics":{a:points(v) for a,v in groups.items()},
            "same_case_skill_effect":paired_effect(groups["joint_empty"],groups["skills"],seed=2026101931,replicates=5000),
            "new_source_ids":[r["id"] for r in self.documents[24:]],"forward_only_no_update":True}
        self.record("batch_summaries/b4_before.json",summary)
        prequential={a:[u for u in self.units if u["stage"].endswith("_prequential") and u["condition"]==a] for a in groups}
        assert all(len(v)==32 and len({u["document_id"] for u in v})==32 for v in prequential.values())
        result={"at":now(),"run_id":self.run_id,"source_run":self.cfg["reference_run"],
            "aggregate_prequential_metrics":{a:points(v) for a,v in prequential.items()},
            "actual_new_native_teacher_CPUfits":[24,0,1],"inherited_actual_native_teacher_CPUfits":[64,3,2],
            "total_same_episode_actual_native_teacher_CPUfits":[88,3,3],
            "B3_actual_published_update_training_effect":effect,"B4_forward_summary":summary,
            "descriptive_all32_skill_effect":paired_effect(prequential["joint_empty"],prequential["skills"],seed=2026101932,replicates=5000),
            "final_bank":self.bank,"units":self.units,"actual_new_ordinary_fits":self.fit_records,
            "actual_source_run_failure_teacher_attempts_and_adverse_B3_preserved":True,
            "not_independent_repeat_official_TEST_or_best_bank_selection":True}
        self.record("completion.json",result)
        RunStore.atomic_json(self.out/"progress.json",{"at":now(),"state":"completed","run_id":self.run_id,
            "completed_native_calls":24,"completed_teacher_calls":0,"same_episode_total":[88,3,3],
            "aggregate_prequential_metrics":result["aggregate_prequential_metrics"]})
        print(json.dumps({"completed":self.run_id,"metrics":result["aggregate_prequential_metrics"]}),flush=True)

with (ROOT/"artifacts/gpu_generation.lock").open("a+") as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock.fileno(),fcntl.LOCK_EX|fcntl.LOCK_NB)
    study=PendingFinalExecution(Path(sys.argv[1]))
    try:study.execute()
    except BaseException as error:
        failure={"at":now(),"state":"failed","error":repr(error),"traceback":traceback.format_exc(),
            "actual_new_native_teacher_calls":[len(study.native),len(study.teachers)],
            "no_retry_answer_repair_bank_selection_or_original_run_mutation":True}
        study.record("failure.json",failure);RunStore.atomic_json(study.out/"progress.json",failure);raise
